name: Kaushik Parthasarathy
title: Software Engineer | Full-Stack, Agentic AI & Distributed Systems
bio:
I like building things I'm curious about, and most of what I build starts with a gap, something I haven't worked with yet, or something happening in the industry I want to understand by actually building it instead of reading about it. That's how a handful of agentic AI projects came together (Donna, Narada, RiskWise, Clinical Copilot, Heimdall), and it's also why I built Atlas, a distributed dispatch system, to get real depth outside of AI work.

I'm comfortable across the stack, Python and FastAPI, Java and Spring Boot, .NET, React, TypeScript, and I adapt to whatever a problem or role actually calls for rather than sticking to one language. That's shown up across both my projects and my professional experience.

I owned production features end to end at Wells Fargo, on portfolio management systems handling $400B+ in assets, backend logic through React UI through OpenShift deployment, and the OpenShift architecture I designed became the standard across the division. At ISRO, I designed a modular computer vision pipeline across four ML models in PyTorch and TensorFlow, cutting real-time inference latency by over 90% through parallel processing.

Currently pursuing an MS in Computer Science at UMass Amherst. Open to SWE and AI/ML roles, internship or full-time.
workAuthorization: F-1 · CPT authorized · Will require STEM OPT / H-1B sponsorship
tagline: Software engineer who builds what he's curious about: full-stack platforms, agentic AI systems, and distributed backend infrastructure, then makes sure they hold up under real load.
